bounds: Five finite line streams cover inline backtick spans, a shorter marker inside a four-backtick fence, an annotated marker inside a fence, a different marker kind, and tilde fences. The parser consumes one line per step. This projection checks field ownership, not the complete Markdown language or arbitrary Unicode/line lengths. The linked parser tests check these streams and exact text preservation; they are concrete cases rather than generated trace replay.

assumptions: Each enabled read, collection or parser step eventually executes and settles (weak fairness). No wall-clock bound is proved.
No fairness is assumed. The environment may indefinitely delay the next enabled step.
